scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backoffice install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,web,backoffice -c yellow,green,blue "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backoffice run dev"
